replies.text:
Open Appeal to Hon’ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi: Dissolution of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly & Imposition of the President's Rule to Restore the Rule of Law

Respected Prime Minister,

The events of Karthigai Deepam at Thiruparankundram have crossed a red line. The Supreme Court permitted a one-time lighting of the ceremonial lamp at the Deepathoon on temple land. Instead of complying, the Tamil Nadu administration deployed thousands of police, imposed prohibitory orders, barricaded the site, and detained hundreds of Hindu devotees, BJP leaders, and Hindu Munnani functionaries who merely sought to witness or ensure the ritual the Court had allowed. The lamp was lit only at the traditional lower spot, not at the Deepathoon as directed. Madras High Court itself ordered compliance and release of those unlawfully detained.

This is not an isolated law-and-order decision. It follows a clear pattern: the earlier DMK-led government and its India-alliance allies moved to impeach a High Court judge for upholding Hindu ritual rights at the same site; the state machinery repeatedly treats court orders upholding Hindu practice as optional; and now even an interim Supreme Court direction is openly defied while Hindus are rounded up. The cumulative message is unmistakable -- dismantling the Hindutva movement, eradicating Sanatan Dharma’s living practices, and denying the Deepam festival itself.

Article 25 guarantees every Hindu the fundamental right to practise religion. When a state government systematically obstructs that right, ignores judicial authority, and uses police power against devotees, the constitutional compact breaks. The psychological, emotional and religious injury to the Hindu way of life in Tamil Nadu is already deep and, if left unchecked, risks becoming irreparable.

Hon’ble Prime Minister, the Tamil Nadu Assembly has demonstrated it cannot or will not protect the constitutional rights of the Hindu community or uphold the supremacy of the judiciary. We therefore urge you to recommend dissolution of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly under Article 356 (or the appropriate constitutional mechanism) so that President’s Rule may restore the rule of law, implement the Supreme Court’s order, release all detainees, and safeguard the right of Hindus to practise their faith without fear or obstruction.

The Centre cannot remain a spectator while Sanatan Dharma is systematically constrained in one state. Decisive action is now required.

Vande Matram,

Akhand Hindurashtra Party (AHP)
